Settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): where it appears (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide down from top, burst out from the middle, circle/radial reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound/vibrate, and opacity. split.note: Split by Claude into 34 steps (3 Fable).

steps.text: Write the phone-connect@1 contract: the device record, pairing handshake, hub sign-in and session security rules (carried over from AmberX), command envelope (open_url, notify, approvals watch, recorder start/stop/status) and wire error codes. Spec doc plus JSON schema.

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.

Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35) and an Axf-themed Compose shell with three tabs (Approvals, Monitor, Settings). This is native and small, not the console.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

Android: Settings tab (paired console, sign-out, notification switches, recorder mic opt-in, Monitor on/off) with Axf controls only. Every setting is also settable from the console API through the command channel.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Write a decision in memory/decisions.md.

Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

Coordinate with the move-build-orchestrator-to-axhub build (axf-molly reads and writes the builds store through axf-data). Tests, help, Shipped features.

At: 2026-11-15T13:36:18.858Z

Notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection gone. AI assistant and agent manager kill it, merge everything into the assistant in the console. Walkthrough video kill it. Open pages on phone keep it. Notifications keep it. Audio recorder, remove it out of console and put the whole thing in the phone app. Wake word listener kill it. Do we need a whole console app?"
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.

Read first: framework/spec/PHONE-CONNECT.md, framework/schemas/phone-connect.json, framework/core/phone-connect.mjs, framework/spec/fixtures/phone-connect.json, framework/spec/check-phone-connect.mjs, apps/console-web/plugins/phone-connect/migrate.mjs
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step phone-connect-small-android-companion <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). split.note: Split by Claude into 34 steps (3 Fable).

steps.text: Write the phone-connect@1 contract: the device record, pairing handshake, hub sign-in and session security rules (carried over from AmberX), command envelope (open_url, notify, approvals watch, recorder start/stop/status) and wire error codes. Spec doc plus JSON schema.
steps.why: New cross-app protocol contract between the console, axHub and the Android companion

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.

Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. Live phone preview, presets, full API parity. The phone just applies the synced config. Split into more steps if needed.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Write a decision in memory/decisions.md.

Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

after.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX

before.detail: Brett's final layout: the console is screens ONLY, with no work and no data in it. New private container 'axf-data' (Coolify, auto-restart, no public port or DNS, internal Docker network only) holds ALL the data: notes, builds store/journal/history, settings, planner items, UI reviews, everything the console stores today. Four parts: console = UI only; axf-molly = does the work (orchestrator, gate, lander); axHub = routes plus credentials/keys only (NO app data stored in axHub); axf-data = stores everything. Goal: if the console goes down, all data and notes stay available (through axHub tools) and builds keep running. Stage it safely: an API in front of the store, migrate with count checks and a backup, run in shadow first, then cut over, and no data is ever lost. Add daily backups. Coordinate with the move-build-orchestrator-to-axhub build (axf-molly reads and writes the builds store through axf-data). Tests, help, Shipped features.

Coordinate with the move-build-orchestrator-to-axhub build (axf-molly reads and writes the builds store through axf-data). Tests, help, Shipped features.

steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.

Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. Live phone preview, presets, full API parity. The phone just applies the synced config. Split into more steps if needed.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Write a decision in memory/decisions.md.

Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

after.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
after.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.

NO phone Settings tab. Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

before.title: Data container: axf-data holds all console data
before.detail: Brett's final layout: the console is screens ONLY, with no work and no data in it. New private container 'axf-data' (Coolify, auto-restart, no public port or DNS, internal Docker network only) holds ALL the data: notes, builds store/journal/history, settings, planner items, UI reviews, everything the console stores today. Four parts: console = UI only; axf-molly = does the work (orchestrator, gate, lander); axHub = routes plus credentials/keys only (NO app data stored in axHub); axf-data = stores everything. Goal: if the console goes down, all data and notes stay available (through axHub tools) and builds keep running. Stage it safely: an API in front of the store, migrate with count checks and a backup, run in shadow first, then cut over, and no data is ever lost. Add daily backups. Coordinate with the move-build-orchestrator-to-axhub build (axf-molly reads and writes the builds store through axf-data). Tests, help, Shipped features.

steps.text: Write the reference core for the contract: validators for the device record and command envelope, and the pairing state machine (unpaired → pending → paired → revoked). Add golden fixtures.
steps.why: Engine internals + conformance fixtures the Android app and server both follow

steps.text: Design the migration: amberx.open_url → phone.open_url and amberx.recorder_* → phone.recorder_* aliases (alias table + deprecation note), output-recorder data dir → phone-connect data dir, and the axHub amberx device record → a phone-connect device. Write the migration script with a dry run.
steps.why: Schema + data migration design across console, axHub tools and stored recordings

steps.text: Inventory before anything is deleted: list every apps/amberx-droid piece (pages, services, Capacitor shell, wake word, voice, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, assistant, agent manager, walkthrough recorder), every console plugin being removed or moved (wake-listener, output-recorder) and the deploy (amberx.amberxai.com) and axHub amberx device. Mark each as kept and ported, merged into the console AI Assistant, or dropped. Commit it as the removal list.

Scaffold the phone-connect console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith Opus, description, lifecycle dataDir, uiEditor none), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, a README and a notify.json declaring the FYI, fix-update, alert and approval notification types.

Build the server device registry and pairing routes on the core: pair code issue/claim, device list/get/revoke, heartbeat/online state. Uses the hub session for sign-in, and only Brett's own session can approve a pairing (personOnly).

Add server command routes: open_url (amberxai.com https only, Chrome or the default browser) and notify (FYI, fix updates, alerts through axf.notify@1). Queue commands for the device, with delivery acks.

Move the whole output recorder out of the output-recorder plugin into phone-connect: session start/stop/status, 30-minute parts, the upload intake to axHub groups, the transcription hook and the opt-in mic switch. Keep the straight-approval rule on start.
Finish the recorder move: point claude-session's automatic recording at phone-connect through a capability (axf.phone-recorder@1), not a folder name, and run the data migration for existing parts.
Add auto-approval rules on the server: rule store (what, scope, expiry), evaluated for the Monitor watch, never covering destructive tools or personOnly actions. Routes to list, add and remove rules.

Expose MCP tools through plugin-commands: phone_devices, phone_pair, phone_revoke, phone_open_url, phone_notify, phone_recorder_start/stop/status, phone_rules_*. Register the amberx_* aliases from the alias table.

Add axHub-side tools: phone.open_url, phone.recorder_start/stop/status, with amberx.* kept as aliases (same policies: recorder_start is a straight approval). Do it as a veto-call PR on MossesX/axHub, or record it as a follow-up item if this checkout can't reach axHub.
Add the CLI: axf phone devices|pair|revoke|open|notify|recorder start/stop/status|rules list/add/remove, all on the same REST routes.

Build the console UI, a Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect sub-tab: device card (online, last seen), pair with QR/code, revoke, notification switches per type, and the level toolbar. Framework controls and tokens only, TabGroup for the tabs.
Build console screens: Recorder (on/off, current part, uploaded parts, queue, start/stop) and Auto-approval rules (list, add, remove), in framework controls only.

API for the UI: console-control targets (data-axf-target) for every screen, tab, setting and button. console_show deep links (view:phone-connect/…), state reads, and voice actions phone.open / phone.notify / phone.recorder.* / phone.pair in the console actions registry.

Create the Android companion app: apps/phone-connect-droid with project.manifest.json, a Gradle app module (ai.amberx.axf.phoneconnect, API 35). NO app screens or tabs (Brett 08:37): only a one-time sign-in/permissions page (incl. 'display over other apps'). Everything visible is the OVERLAY: a floating always-on-top toolbar (from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status) that collapses to a small draggable button (remembers spot and state, badge count), and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that you can act on in place (approve or deny right from the popup). Themed live by the console's skin and theme tokens (Axf.colors/type/space/shapes) with no new APK. Split into more steps if needed.
Android: port hub sign-in and session security from amberx-droid (hub session storage, token refresh, sign-out, pairing claim screen) onto the phone-connect@1 pairing flow.

Android: port the Approvals page (list, detail with reason title/description, Approve / Deny / Shelve with Brett's own hub session) and alerts. The lock screen shows only 'Approval waiting' (VISIBILITY_SECRET content plus a public version).
Android: port Monitor as the WatchService foreground service: approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rule evaluation (rules synced from the server), and a persistent low-priority notification.

Android: command channel plus open page. Receive phone-connect@1 commands, then for open_url (amberxai.com https only) bring Chrome or the default browser to the front, with a high-priority tap-to-open notification fallback when a background start is blocked. Ack each delivery.
Android: phone notifications. Channels for FYI, fix updates, alerts and approvals, matching notify.json, with per-type switches synced from the console settings.

Android: move the whole Audio Output Recorder in from amberx-droid. MediaProjection playback capture (mic only with the opt-in switch), 30-minute parts named '<session> - <date> - partN', an upload queue to axHub groups, and status reports.

NO phone Settings tab. Instead, in the CONSOLE plugin, build an Overlay settings screen synced live to the phone: (1) a toolbar editor (reuse the framework toolbar/widget editor) to add, remove and reorder buttons and widgets, pick icons, set labels and actions (open a console page, approve, recorder, notifications, build status); (2) settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): position (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide from top, burst from the middle, circle reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound or vibrate, and opacity; (3) toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, auto-collapse; (4) paired device, Monitor on/off, recorder mic opt-in. Live phone preview, presets, full API parity. The phone just applies the synced config. Split into more steps if needed.

CI: build the Phone Connect APK in .github/workflows/android.yml (artifact phone-connect-debug.apk), add the app to conform checks and the shared-assets list if needed, and update the Android-on-hold exception to name Phone Connect in place of AmberX.
Merge AmberX's phone AI assistant and agent manager into the console AI Assistant: carry over anything it has that the console assistant lacks (per the inventory), or note it as covered.

Remove the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic: run uninstall.mjs --all, delete the folder and its lifecycle-marked doc lines, pass plugin-lifecycle check --after-uninstall, and shift the help ratchet.
Remove the emptied output-recorder plugin (uninstall.mjs --all, lifecycle check), leaving only the aliases in phone-connect.

Tests: Python tests for pairing, commands, recorder, rules and aliases; check-phone-connect fixtures; console-control and toolbar/theme/chrome checks on the new UI; a Kotlin unit test for lock-screen visibility and URL filtering.
Help, Shipped features and glossary: help pages for Phone Connect (console and phone), each feature described at its definition, a deploy-log line, and catalog --check passing.

UI Review: submit console desktop and phone shots plus Android screens with at least 3 options each as assets (settings interface takes one). Ask Brett for the group name, or use the build-id group when headless.

Retirement gate script: verify Phone Connect is installed and working (device paired, heartbeat online, a test notify acked, open_url acked, recorder status answers). Retirement below runs only if it passes, otherwise it is recorded as waiting on Brett's phone.

Retire AmberX after the gate: delete apps/amberx-droid and its manifest, drop it from shared-assets, the rules and the CI APK job, and remove the amberx.amberxai.com deploy (Coolify app and DNS record logged in the DNS log) and the axHub amberx device as veto calls with reasons. Tests, report and landing: run the full check sweep, write _claude/builds/reports/phone-connect-small-android-companion.md (removal list, API reach for each feature: deep link / REST / MCP / CLI / voice, aliases, gaps), add the THREADS.md row, open the PR stating how each feature is reached and that UI Review is waiting, link it with builds-live, and land it with the one-at-a-time lander.

Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.

[ ] s6 (~8 min) CLI: 'axf feature open <id|name>' and 'axf feature target <id|name>' (and the matching subcommands in the plugin's own .mjs CLI) that call the REST routes; smoke test
[ ] s7 (~8 min) Voice (AmberX): add the 'open feature X' / 'show me feature X' intent mapped to feature.open, with a reply naming the screen or the reason it can't open; intent test

[ ] s9 (~10 min) Put the Open button on every Shipped features grid row and add an 'Open in app' row context-menu item (rt.addContextItems, disabled with the reason when there's no target); deep link view:shipped-features/row:<id>/action:open
[ ] s10 (~10 min) Gate plugin: show the same Open button in Pending features expanded rows once the build has landed (go through the shipped-features capability service, not its folder name; before it lands, keep it hidden or disabled with the reason 'not landed yet')
[ ] s11 (~8 min) Gate API parity: expose the open target on the Gate's pending-feature read (REST field + MCP) so the state shows up there too; tests

[ ] s13 (~10 min) Run the checks: plugin tests, check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-console-control, plugin-lifecycle check, glossary catalog --check, console typecheck/build; fix what fails

[ ] s15 (~10 min) Finish the report _claude/builds/reports/shipped-features-open-button-views-each.md (what was added, how it's reached over REST/MCP/CLI/voice/deep link, test results), add a THREADS.md row, push the branch, open the PR saying UI Review is waiting and listing each API path, link it with builds-live.mjs link and add it to the lander queue

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

# Build: shipped-features-open-button-views-each

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-15T14:55:29.131Z
> I want the shipped features to have a button to open the feature, to view the feature in the live app.

## What to build
Continue build "Shipped features: Open button views each feature in the live app" (shipped-features-open-button-views-each) — Phase 1, model Opus.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-15 14:55):
"I want the shipped features to have a button to open the feature, to view the feature in the live app."
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Steps in this phase (15 left, ~2.3 h):
[ ] s1 (~8 min) Read the shipped-features plugin (feature-ledger@1 store, routes, UI rows) and the Gate plugin's Pending features expanded rows; write a short plan in _claude/builds/reports/shipped-features-open-button-views-each.md naming where each feature record's console_show target lives and how features with no screen are detected
[ ] s2 (~10 min) Add an openTarget resolver to the shipped-features server: from a feature record give back {target, label} or {target:null, reason} (no screen, not live yet, unknown address), checking the target against the console-control registry; unit test
[ ] s3 (~10 min) REST: GET /api/plugins/shipped-features/features/{id}/open-target (state read) and POST /api/plugins/shipped-features/features/{id}/open (runs console_show / console_open on the target, or returns 409 with the reason); route tests
[ ] s4 (~8 min) Add a fuzzy feature lookup (by id, title or keywords) so 'open feature X' can name a feature in words; return the best match plus close alternatives when it's ambiguous; tests
[ ] s5 (~8 min) MCP + console actions: register plugin commands shipped-features_open and shipped-features_open_target (by id or name) and a console action 'feature.open' so they show up in console_control and plugin-commands
[ ] s6 (~8 min) CLI: 'axf feature open <id|name>' and 'axf feature target <id|name>' (and the matching subcommands in the plugin's own .mjs CLI) that call the REST routes; smoke test
[ ] s7 (~8 min) Voice (AmberX): add the 'open feature X' / 'show me feature X' intent mapped to feature.open, with a reply naming the screen or the reason it can't open; intent test
[ ] s8 (~10 min) UI: shared <FeatureOpenButton> in the shipped-features plugin (framework Button, tokens only, in the row's toolbar with role=toolbar + aria-label, disabled with the reason as its tooltip when there's no target, data-axf-target registered) that calls POST open
[ ] s9 (~10 min) Put the Open button on every Shipped features grid row and add an 'Open in app' row context-menu item (rt.addContextItems, disabled with the reason when there's no target); deep link view:shipped-features/row:<id>/action:open
[ ] s10 (~10 min) Gate plugin: show the same Open button in Pending features expanded rows once the build has landed (go through the shipped-features capability service, not its folder name; before it lands, keep it hidden or disabled with the reason 'not landed yet')
[ ] s11 (~8 min) Gate API parity: expose the open target on the Gate's pending-feature read (REST field + MCP) so the state shows up there too; tests
[ ] s12 (~8 min) Help + docs: help entries for the Open button, the context item and the commands; README sections for both plugins; descriptions for the glossary/catalog; lifecycle markers on any doc line outside the plugin folders
[ ] s13 (~10 min) Run the checks: plugin tests, check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-console-control, plugin-lifecycle check, glossary catalog --check, console typecheck/build; fix what fails
[ ] s14 (~10 min) Screenshots (desktop + phone) of the enabled and disabled button in Shipped features and Gate; submit to UI Review with 3 choices (button only / button + icon / icon in the row toolbar) as assets under plugins/shipped-features/assets/
[ ] s15 (~10 min) Finish the report _claude/builds/reports/shipped-features-open-button-views-each.md (what was added, how it's reached over REST/MCP/CLI/voice/deep link, test results), add a THREADS.md row, push the branch, open the PR saying UI Review is waiting and listing each API path, link it with builds-live.mjs link and add it to the lander queue

As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step shipped-features-open-button-views-each <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. before.title: Phone Connect: small Android companion + console plugin; retire AmberX
before.detail: Replace the AmberX app with Phone Connect. Two parts: (A) a console plugin 'phone-connect' for screens, settings and pairing, with full API parity; (B) a SMALL native Android companion app, not the whole console, for phone-only work. KEEP and port from apps/amberx-droid: 1) the Approvals page with alerts, including the lock screen showing only 'Approval waiting'; 2) Monitor: background WatchService foreground service, approvals watch, alerts, auto-approval rules; 3) open a page on the phone (bring Chrome to the front; keep the amberx.open_url tool working in axHub, renamed phone.open_url with an alias); 4) phone notifications (FYI and fix updates, alerts); 5) the audio output recorder: move the WHOLE thing out of the console's output-recorder plugin into Phone Connect (recorder_start/stop/status tools move too, with aliases). DROP: voice commands, notes, dictation, web tabs, AI connection, the phone AI assistant and agent manager (everything merges into the console AI Assistant), the walkthrough video and recorder, and the wake word listener. Also REMOVE the console wake-listener plugin and the always-on wake mic, because it grabs Brett's mic. Keep the hub sign-in and session security rules. Before deleting anything, list every AmberX piece and console plugin being removed, then retire apps/amberx-droid, the amberx.amberxai.com deploy, and the axHub amberx device, once Phone Connect is installed and working. CI builds the APK. Tests, help, Shipped features. Land with the one-at-a-time lander.

notes.text: Queued by console.

Brett (08:37): the phone app has NO screens of its own. It is a background service plus a one-time sign-in/permissions page only. Approvals, Monitor rules, recorder controls and all settings live in the console plugin; tapping a notification opens the matching console page in the browser.

Brett (08:38): CORRECTION, the phone app DOES show things on screen as an OVERLAY. Fold in the floating always-on-top toolbar overlay from build amberx-floating-toolbar-always-on-top-mic-approvals-build-status (approvals, build status, notifications widget). Approvals and alerts pop up right on the phone screen over other apps, and he can approve from the overlay. Settings still live in the console. List what that old build already did before porting it.

Brett (08:39): the overlay toolbar collapses to a small floating button (draggable, remembers its spot and its collapsed/expanded state); tap to expand, tap to collapse. A new approval or alert pops up from the button even while it's collapsed, with a badge count.

Brett (08:40): lots of overlay settings, all in the console plugin and synced to the phone. Settings for each popup type (approvals, alerts, notifications): where it appears (top, bottom, center, corners, from the button), entry/exit animation (slide down from top, burst out from the middle, circle/radial reveal, fade, scale, bounce), speed, size, how long it stays, sound/vibrate, and opacity. Settings for the toolbar and button: size, shape, edge snapping, and auto-collapse delay. Live preview in the console, presets, and full API parity.

Brett (08:41): the overlay, button, toolbar and popups are themed by the console's current skin and theme (same tokens through Axf.colors/type/space/shapes on Android). When he changes the skin or theme in the console, the phone overlay updates live without a new APK.
